for (const [lang, keys] of Object.entries(byLang)) {
  const full = path.join(dir, lang + '.json');
  const j = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(full, 'utf8'));
  if (!j.ASTRO_COMPASS) {
    console.log('skip', lang);
    continue;
  }
  Object.assign(j.ASTRO_COMPASS, keys);
  fs.writeFileSync(full, JSON.stringify(j, null, 2) + '\n');
  console.log('ok', lang);
}
